title: Workshop with Sebastian de la Vallina : The Art of Connection
description: Welcome to workshop with Sebastian de la Vallina, a wonderful teacher, dancer, musician and human! One of Tangoskolen's absolute favorites! No one else teaches tango like this man <3 Do not miss this!!! Workshop TOPIC : The Art of Connection This seminar is for ALL LEVELS (minimum a beginners course in the past please) We recommend that you sign up with a partner on your own level. If you register without a partner, we will try our best to find someone suitable for you to dance with. We expect you to be open minded and want to inform you that we only focus on dancing roles, not gender <3 The workshop is 3 hours included short breaks. The price is 500 NOK per person. Sign up today! Follow this link -> https://tangoskolenosloregistration.wordpress.com/ <3
